mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_change WHERE change_id=#{changeId} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND verification_status='VERIFIED'
SELECT es.*, c.title AS change_title FROM zentide_evidence_submission es JOIN zentide_change c ON c.change_id=es.change_id WHERE es.status='CANDIDATE' ORDER BY es.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM zentide_evidence_submission WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND status='CANDIDATE' LIMIT 1

SELECT dv.document_version_id, d.source_id, s.source_name, s.canonical_url AS source_url, s.trust_tier FROM zentide_document_version dv JOIN zentide_document d ON d.document_id=dv.document_id JOIN zentide_source s ON s.source_id=d.source_id WHERE dv.document_version_id=#{documentVersionId} AND s.status='ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_document_version WHERE document_version_id=#{documentVersionId} AND LOCATE(#{excerpt},normalized_content)>0
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_evidence_submission SET status='APPROVED',reviewed_by=#{actorId},review_note=#{reviewNote},accepted_evidence_id=#{evidenceId},reviewed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND status='CANDIDATE'
UPDATE zentide_evidence_submission SET status='REJECTED',reviewed_by=#{actorId},review_note=#{reviewNote},reviewed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND status='CANDIDATE'
